organization.name: Ontario Home Respiratory Services Association
organization.address: 155 University Avenue,Suite #1900, Toronto, Ontario, M5H 3B7, Canada
organization.description: OHRSA represents Ontario home respiratory service providers, its members are dedicated to the highest standard of home respiratory care in the world.

lobbying_activities.goal: General discussions regarding the Home Oxygen Program, the CPAP (Continuous Positive Airway Pressure) Therapy program and other respiratory therapy programs funded by the Assistive Devices Branch of the Ministry of Health. The lobbying goals include improving and expediting the administrative processes of the programs listed above; ensure respiratory services meet the strategic objectives of the Ontario government; and provide advice on the provision of respiratory services and improvement of services.
